method: KitLink against a simulated PLC latch (150 ms) and web machine (300 ms start), 100 ms polling

tests.name: X0: PLC latch on → web machine starts, nothing is sent back to the PLC
X1: PLC latch off → web machine stops, nothing is sent back
X0 then X1 before the web finished starting → start cancelled, web stays stopped
Web START button while PLC stopped → one START request, PLC follows (Y5)
Web STOP button while running → one STOP request, PLC follows (Y6)
PLC refuses START (not armed) → web machine is stopped again, both stopped
Web cannot start (E-STOP / tab hidden) → PLC told to stop, no retry loop
Fault stops the web while running → PLC stopped, never restarted automatically
Connect while the PLC is already running → web starts to match
Connect while the web is running but PLC stopped → web stops to match
Steady running for 60 s → no actions, no requests
Web START then web STOP before the PLC answered → both end stopped
Web link lost (PLC drops latch by heartbeat) → web machine stops
Many presses in a row (X0, X1, X0, X1, X0) → ends running, never a request
Demo restart while running (web stops then starts again at once) → ends running on both sides
Web STOP then web START again before the PLC answered → both end running
